The *Ucchuvimānavatthu* (Vv 48) is a canonical verse text of the *Vimānavatthu* in the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya. In this poem, translated as "Sugarcane Mansion", a celestial being (*deva*) recounts the karmic fruits obtained by having given a small piece of sugarcane to the Arahant Moggallāna.
